title: Chicken Shawarma
subtitle: Middle Eastern spiced roasted chicken with garlic sauce
excerpt: The great Middle Eastern rotisserie dish made at home: chicken thighs marinated in warm spices, lemon, and olive oil, then roasted at high heat until caramelised and fragrant. Carved and served in flatbread with garlic sauce, pickled vegetables, and fresh herbs.

recipe.sourceNotes: Shawarma (from the Turkish çevirme, meaning turning) is a method of cooking meat on a vertical rotisserie spit over a heat source, shaving the meat as it cooks. The dish is found across the Levant, Turkey, and the broader Middle East, with variations using lamb, beef, chicken, or mixed meats. The spice blend varies by country: Lebanese shawarma uses allspice, cinnamon, and cardamom; Turkish döner uses oregano and paprika; Israeli shawarma uses turmeric and cumin. Home cooks achieve a reasonable approximation by roasting the chicken on a rack in a very hot oven or under a grill after marinating. The essential accompaniment is toum, the Lebanese garlic sauce (raw garlic emulsified with oil and lemon juice), and either pickled turnips or the quick-pickled cabbage and cucumber that vendors provide.

content.text: A longer marinade (overnight) produces much deeper flavour than a short one; the spices need time to penetrate the meat. Roast at high heat on a rack so the hot air circulates around the chicken and the fat drips away. The chicken should be deeply caramelised at the edges with some charring. Slice thinly across the grain to serve.

Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, grated garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, allspice, cayenne, and salt to make the marinade. Add the chicken thighs and coat thoroughly. Marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight in the fridge.

Heat the oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Place the chicken thighs on a wire rack set over a baking tray. Roast for 30 to 35 minutes until caramelised and cooked through, with some charring at the thinner edges. Rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken thinly. Serve in warm flatbread with plain yogurt or garlic sauce, sliced tomato, and flat parsley. Add pickled chillies or cucumber if you like.
